Bio:
Mobile Developer presso EBWorld e Maintainer del package MapLibre Flutter, sono specializzato nello sviluppo di applicazioni mobile con cartografia avanzata. La mia missione è portare i dati geospaziali fuori dagli uffici: sviluppo app in Flutter che trasformano infrastrutture complesse (come reti elettriche o acquedotti) in strumenti operativi essenziali per chi lavora fisicamente sul campo._x000D_
_x000D_
Scrivo codice fin da giovanissimo, spinto dalla curiosità di esplorare i limiti delle tecnologie che utilizzo. Oltre al mio lavoro in EBWorld, contribuisco attivamente all'open source per migliorare gli strumenti su cui i developer fanno affidamento ogni giorno. _x000D_
Come speaker, amo portare sul palco casi d'uso concreti, traducendo sfide architetturali complesse in soluzioni pratiche per la community.

TagLine: GDE Cloud | Senior Enterprise Architect @ adesso.it | Community Manager @ GDG Pescara
Bio: I have been working in the IT industry for over 15 years. I currently hold the role of Senior Enterprise Architect in adesso.it. I am a Google Developer Expert on GCP and a Google Cloud Innovator Champion on the topic of modern architecture. I manage GDG Pescara together with other developers, I love sharing my knowledge and trying to do it in a fun way.

Engineer & Digital entrepreneur. I took the master degree in computer engineering with a thesis on AI at Polytechnic University of Bari in 2007. I worked for several years in ICT companies in Italy as a backend software developer. I attended the Mind The Bridge startup school in San Francisco in 2011. Back in Italy I started working on my own companies. Now, I'm the CTO of Wideverse, a spin-off of the Polytechnic University of Bari that works on XR and AI technologies. In addition I'm the founder and the current lead of Google Developer Group Bari community.  I’m a public speaker globetrotter nerd with the passion for SUP, running, Rock and photography. BBQ and IPA beers addicted.

Sono un professionista nel mondo della crescita digitale e della tecnologia, con un percorso costruito tra startup, prodotti digitali e strategie di sviluppo. Nel corso degli anni ho lanciato nuove iniziative, validato idee, costruito funnel e lavorato con team per trasformare intuizioni in soluzioni concrete.

By day, I’m a Lead Software Developer, and by night, I’m an AI student exploring where Cloud, DevOps, and Machine Learning overlap. I’ve always believed that writing the code is the easy part—the real challenge is engineering it for scale, resilience, and making sure it stays maintainable long-term._x000D_
_x000D_
In my current role, I spend most of my time on distributed systems architecture and the day-to-day chaos of production deployments. I’m big on automating workflows, not just for the sake of it, but to actually make the developer experience suck less._x000D_
_x000D_
When I’m not debugging systems or training models, I’m usually looking for ways to automate my own job or helping the next generation of engineers avoid the mistakes I’ve already made.

Bio: I am a Solutions Architect at Online Partner AB and a Cloud GDE. I have worked on several projects involving Google Cloud services and Google Workspace along with multiple other technology stacks and platforms.

His experience started in Switzerland for an Android project in the medical field and continued for large companies such as NTT Data and Deloitte, until he got to his current Capgemini. His life is not only programming, but also football, padel and an obsession with Lego!

TagLine: AWS Hero | CTO/Solution Architect | Community Lead (AWS, GDG, PLUG) | Co-founder of 'Come To Code'
Bio:
Maurizio is a CTO, Solution Architect, and AWS Hero based in Basilicata, Italy. With a technical core rooted in Java, Python, and Django, he blends deep architectural expertise with a decade of experience in Project Management and community leadership._x000D_
_x000D_
As the founder of the AWS User Group Basilicata and co-founder of 'Come To Code'—the largest IT conference in Southern Italy—Maurizio is a driving force in the Italian tech ecosystem. He also leads GDG Basilicata and the PLUG (Pignola Linux User Group), where he has spent over 10 years promoting Open Source culture and digital literacy._x000D_
_x000D_
Maurizio’s mission is to prove that innovation knows no boundaries. Whether speaking at international stages or hosting local meetups, he focuses on bridging the gap between high-level cloud innovation and regional territories. He believes that real progress happens through human connection and is dedicated to fostering inclusive spaces where tech hubs can thrive anywhere—from major cities to small mountain villages.

I am a young man born in 2000 and I am currently finishing my studies in computer science at the Ca' Foscari University of Venice, located in Mestre, in addition to being a full-time web developer._x000D_
In addition to studying, I love playing role-playing games, skateboarding and playing Magic the Gathering.
